description: List schedule annotations — announcements, business-closed days and blackout dates when time off is not allowed. Defaults to today through one year out. When I Work: GET /2/annotations.

end_date.description: End of the range (default one year after start). Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

no_time_off.description: Only annotations that block time off.

start_date.description: Start of the range (default the start of today). Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

name: wheniwork_list_annotations
title: List schedule annotations
